bullets.text: Apple MacBook Pros Incoming - New **M5** models expected on March 4, alongside other product launches.
Apple's Unique Launch Format - March event may feature multiple press releases instead of a traditional keynote.
iPadOS 26.4 Beta Released - New features available for iPad users, including enhanced Safari functionality.
iOS 26.4 Prepares for CarPlay - New beta reveals support for video playback while parked.
Apple Music Teams with TikTok - New features allow full song playback and collaborative listening.
AI Wearables from Apple - New AI-powered glasses and pendant reportedly in development.
Google Pixel 10A Launch - New affordable smartphone set to debut on February 18.
Mistral AI Acquires Koyeb - First acquisition aims to bolster cloud capabilities.
Ford's $30,000 Electric Truck - New strategy combines innovative manufacturing and F1 expertise.
Meta's AI Chip Deal - Partnership with **Nvidia** to enhance data center capabilities.
